text:
marie_cs: KelpStream reached out — they want us to onboard a hybrid 7B reranker for their retail search. Requirements: on‑prem Private deployment, HSM for keying PHI tokens, multilingual (EN/ES/FR), p95 latency target ~180ms, and first pilot in their EU data center. Can engineering and evals confirm feasibility and a rough timeline? cc @ravi_se @olga_eval :wave:

ravi_se: Quick take — technically doable but a few caveats. We can run a quantized INT8 7B variant and hit ~120–220ms p95 depending on sequence length and batching. HSM on‑prem is the bigger lift: we support KMS today, HSM will need infra ops + security signoff and a small agent on their side. Need model artifact, sample traffic, and perf traces to give a firm SLA.

olga_eval: From safety/evals perspective — because they want PHI protection + HSM, we should run three focused eval suites: 1) privacy leakage / redaction tests, 2) hallucination/regression tests on their catalog, 3) multilingual parity checks. Also require a labeled set (~200 queries per language) and any PHI tokenization rules they use (regexes).

jordan_pm: Account note — KelpStream is mid‑enterprise, current Dedicated utilization ~65%. There's a renewal conversation in 8 weeks; if onboarding drags we risk churn or discount pressure. Suggest a 2‑week pilot with reserved pool to de‑risk and show value. Can CS propose a pilot SLA and timeline to present at renewal?

marie_cs: Customer is willing to sign a 30‑day pilot SLA if we can commit a small Dedicated pool and HSM integration ETA. They're asking for a simple 5‑step onboarding map they can share internally. Can we produce that and confirm owners before Tues call?

ravi_se: Proposed 5 steps (high level):
1) Access & artifacts — customer uploads model + tokenization rules + sample traffic.
2) Infra prep — infra to validate HSM connectivity and deploy private agent.
3) Perf & safety runs — run perf bench + eval suites (olga).
4) Pilot deploy — enable dedicated pool, monitor for 30 days, collect UX metrics.
5) Handover & SLA — final runbook + production cutover.

Quick bench command (dev-only example):
```
run-bench --model kelp-7b-quant --seq 256 --batch 1 --hsm true --region eu-west-1
```
Need model url + sample traces to start.

ops-bot: Created ticket CS-4592: "KelpStream — 7B onprem HSM onboarding" and linked infra playbook https://redwood.example/onboard/CS-4592 :thumbsup:

olga_eval: Also: flag for policy group — if PHI present we must run extra dataflow review. I'll spin up the eval harness but need labeled queries and expected redaction outputs.

marie_cs: Scheduling note — set customer sync for Tue 09:30 CET. Owners requested: @ravi_se (technical lead), @olga_eval (evals), @marie_cs (CS owner). Jordan, will you own renewal touchpoint?

jordan_pm: I'll handle renewal comms and prepare commercial playbook. I'll join the Tue call. Please add any pre-reads to the ticket.

marie_cs: Thanks — next actions: ravi to confirm infra ETA (48–72h for initial feasibility), olga to outline eval plan (deliverable by EOD Fri), me to send pilot SLA draft to customer. If we can hit pilot start within 2 weeks, we should be good for renewal.

ravi_se: Acknowledged. I'll open an infra PR and ping security for HSM checklist.

olga_eval: Acknowledged, will post eval checklist to CS-4592 and request data samples.

marie_cs: Great — adding a short customer quote for context in the ticket: "We need PHI-safe reranking with <180ms p95 and EU hosting — pilot asap."

(ends)
